meta.title: The Meat Grinder Needs More Meat

hero.title: The Meat Grinder Needs More Meat
hero.subtitle: Why billionaires panic about birth rates, why the Venn diagram collapsed, and why the earth is quietly exhausted.
paragraphs: You know why the total fertility rate is in freefall worldwide and people simply refuse to have children? Listen to politicians and tech billionaires whine, and they’ll tell you society is collapsing because younger generations became selfish. What they really mean is: the meat grinder is running out of meat.
They do not care about procreation or the dignity of human life. They care about future taxpayers to fund pension deficits, and warm bodies to keep consumer demand humming.

circles.label: Family Support
circles.description: Multi-generational care, community time & domestic bandwidth

circles.label: Social Policies & Housing
circles.description: Accessible housing, urban livability & public childcare

circles.label: Financial Sustainability
circles.description: Real wage security, career stability & predictable costs

cards.copy: For having a child to be a rational, joyful decision rather than an act of financial self-harm, three circles have to intersect: Family Support, Social Policies & Housing, and Financial Sustainability.
cards.citation: Ref: UN DESA 'World Population Prospects 2024' & OECD Family Database (Replacement TFR = 2.1)

cards.copy: Over the last thirty years, dual-income burnout pulled Family Support outward, housing financialization yanked Social Policies away, and stagnant wages dragged Financial Sustainability through the floor.
cards.citation: Ref: OECD 'Society at a Glance 2024' — Total Fertility Rate Across 38 OECD Member Economies

cards.metricLabel: EAST & SOUTHEAST ASIAN URBAN TFR FLOOR
cards.copy: Where the overlapping center once read 'Make Baby', there is now a structural vacuum: the TFR Black Hole. South Korea sits at 0.72. Singapore hit 0.97. No amount of moral lecturing can close a broken geometry.
cards.citation: Ref: Statistics Korea (KOSTAT 2024) & Singapore Department of Statistics Population in Brief (2024)

steps.copy: How do you ask people to breed future workers for an economy that is simultaneously bragging about replacing entry-level careers with AI? You cannot saw off the bottom rungs of the economic ladder and act shocked when nobody wagers a 20-year dependent on it.
steps.crowdUnit: FULL-TIME ROLES EXPOSED TO AI AUTOMATION
steps.citation: Ref: Goldman Sachs Global Macro Research (2023) & WEF 'Future of Jobs Report' (2025)

steps.copy: Governments hand out fertility brochures while low-lying coastal cities quietly model chronic 2050 sea-level flooding, lethal wet-bulb heatwaves, and severe water stress. Young people aren't nihilists—they can simply read a climate chart.
steps.citation: Ref: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) & Climate Central Coastal DEM 2050 Projections

steps.phaseTitle: The Paid Gig Baby (BTO & Subsidy Illusions)
steps.copy: Throwing a one-off baby bonus or a 5-year waitlisted micro-flat at a 25-year cost crisis treats parenthood like an underpaid gig job. A $10,000 cash token against $310,000+ of housing, childcare, and tuition inflation is an insult to basic arithmetic.
steps.crowdUnit: LIFETIME CHILD COST VS TOKEN CASH SUBSIDY
steps.citation: Ref: Brookings Institution Cost of Raising a Child & OECD Family Cash Benefits Database (2024)

steps.copy: Today's working adults are already serving as the private safety net for their own aging parents amidst vanishing pensions and surging medical costs. Expecting a generation crushed between eldercare and 60-hour workweeks to add another dependent is delusional.
steps.aftermathCopy: The meat grinder does not care about families. It only cares about fresh collateral.
steps.crowdUnit: ADULTS SIMULTANEOUSLY FUNDING ELDER & SELF CARE
steps.citation: Ref: Pew Research Center 'The Sandwich Generation' & National Transfer Accounts (2024)

terminalSolutions.subtitle: What if we stop pretending birth rates are returning to 2.1 and redesign civilization around reality?

propositions.title: 01: Redefining the Family Unit
propositions.lead: Decouple public housing, tax law, and healthcare rights from nuclear biological reproduction.
propositions.body: Right now, housing allocation (like BTO schemes) and tax codes punish single adults and non-traditional households to coerce marriage and childbirth. Legalizing platonic co-living cooperatives, multi-adult household equity, and chosen-family care networks lets citizens pool resources and mutual care without forced procreation.
propositions.citation: Ref: OECD Household Projections (2024–2040) & European Collaborative Housing Index

propositions.title: 02: Normalising End-of-Life Dignity (Euthanasia)
propositions.lead: Replace forced biological prolongation with autonomous, dignified end-of-life choice.
propositions.body: Modern medicine excels at keeping organs ticking long after agency, cognition, and quality of life have vanished—draining over 25% of lifetime healthcare expenditure in the final months of agony. Normalising voluntary, safeguarded end-of-life dignity honors human autonomy and lifts an immense emotional and financial terror from aging societies.
propositions.citation: Ref: The Lancet Commission on the Value of Death (2022) & OECD Health at a Glance (2024)

propositions.title: 03: Dismantling Infinite GDP Growth
propositions.lead: Treat population stabilization as an ecological rescue rather than a capitalist emergency.
propositions.body: A finite biosphere already operating at 1.7x ecological overshoot does not need 10 billion consumers churning disposable goods to prop up quarterly GDP. Shifting from aggregate GDP growth to per-capita well-being, automated public dividends, and ecological restoration turns a smaller population into humanity's greatest dividend.
propositions.citation: Ref: Global Footprint Network (2024) & Hickel et al., 'Degrowth & Post-Growth Economics' (Nature, 2022)

conclusion.statementLead: Maybe declining birth rates aren't an extinction crisis at all. Maybe it is the human species quietly refusing to feed an extractive machine—and giving an exhausted planet its first chance to breathe.
conclusion.statementPunchline: Stop demanding more meat for the grinder. Build a world worth being born into.
